about: The app spaces the dashboard shows (src/dashboard.ts, docs/dashboard.en.md): each app's addresses in turn, the unix socket of a plain start, the loopback port docker:local publishes, then the loopback port on big (a tunnel to nano for the chat and the help system, the region's own port for the world). space names a named space of that service, * every space it lists (stats only). The spaces-mmo accounts space (credentials, sessions) is left out on purpose; the help hub serves only figures. DASHBOARD_APPS and --app replace this list; an id of it keeps its label and space.
